source_records.locator: get_all/get_all_at/get_cursor; Authors and Actors; apply_changes/save; Transactable and manual_transaction

source_records.governing_condition_and_applicability: Author metadata is not authentication; save serializes bytes rather than flushing storage. JS API spelling/frequency advice is not a Rust adapter proof.

source_records.locator: state.rs 27-78,108-150; sync.rs 238-253,279-287,386-463; inline read-only/in-flight tests inspected
source_records.independent_observation: Native encode saves only shared_heads. Decode initializes other live protocol fields afresh, including in_flight, sent_hashes, peer heads, capabilities and read_only. Generation/receipt reads and mutates those fields.

source_records.version_context: Rust yrs0.28.0; package VCS23b7f5693bbf9e7d26340c521ee8647f79bdfba2; package checksum recorded below
source_records.locator: Root ClientID warning/MapRef rules; TransactionMut apply_update/encode_update; StickyIndex description
source_records.independent_observation: Updates ignore duplicate blocks and buffer missing predecessors; convergence still needs eventual delivery. Active peers require distinct ClientIDs or concurrent changes can corrupt state. Map conflicts use a deterministic ClientID tie-break; StickyIndex follows blocks and supports serialization.
source_records.governing_condition_and_applicability: Cue IDs differ from writer ClientIDs. Stable text positions have empty/deleted-target conditions and do not replace cue identity. Treatment drops the supported writer-identity safety condition from its self-contained final.
